in_sanskrit.name: Minhaz
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Jewel, Treasure
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Minhaz एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Minhaz is derived from the Persian word 'minj' which means 'jewel' or 'treasure'. In Hindu culture, it is believed that this name brings wealth and prosperity.
